card.name: Linking words in all-caps boxed warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as OTHER, AND, WITH, OF or a colon inside ALL-CAPS boxed-warning headings, right before the next warning term.

modes.label: OTHER before a drug or risk
modes.description: The word OTHER in capitalized warning text, leading into drugs or malignancies.
modes.example: CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF<< OTHER>> DRUGS WITH RESPIRATORY

modes.label: AND/OF/colon in warning titles
modes.description: Linking words or a colon in capitalized lists of warning headings.

card.plain: It marks small connecting words in the capitalized headline of a boxed warning, just before the next risk is named.
